in_marathi.name: Kavika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Goddess of the Stars and constellations. In Hindu mythology, Kavika is the name of the goddess of stars and constellations. She is also known as Astra-Gauri, the goddess of celestial bodies. Kavika is believed to watch over the night sky and protect her children.
